ph_token=apis.phone.login(username='3272301258', password=creds['phone'])['access_token']
parents=[]
for rel in ['mother','father','parent']:
    page=0
    while True:
        resp=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=ph_token, query='', relationship=rel, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        if not resp:
            break
        parents.extend(resp)
        page+=1
        if page>50:
            break
seen=set(); uniq=[]
for c in parents:
    if not c.get('email'): 
        continue
    if c['email'] in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(c['email'])
    uniq.append(c)

# map to gmail users
# login gmail to get access_token only; search_users is public (no token requirement)
# but we still need gm_login for send_email later.

gm_login=apis.gmail.login(username='jefsmith@gmail.com', password=creds['gmail'])
gm_token=gm_login['access_token']

mapped=[]
for c in uniq:
    email=c['email']
    page=0
    results=[]
    while True:
        resp=apis.gmail.search_users(query=email, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
        if not resp:
            break
        results.extend(resp)
        page+=1
        if page>50:
            break
    exact=[r for r in results if r.get('email','').lower()==email.lower()]
    if len(exact)==1:
        mapped.append(exact[0])
    elif len(exact)>1:
        print('AMBIGUITY UNRESOLVED for', email, ':', len(exact), 'candidates, EXCLUDING.')

recipient_emails=[m['email'] for m in mapped]

subject='Good Old Times'
body='See attached.'
attachment_file_paths=[zip_path]

print('VERIFICATION_TABLE_FINAL')
for r in recipient_emails:
    print({'to': r, 'subject': subject, 'body': body, 'attachment_file_paths': attachment_file_paths})

print('PAYLOAD_COUNTS:', {'recipients': len(recipient_emails), 'attachments': len(attachment_file_paths)})

# Criteria enumeration gate for sending email with attachment

    ('Body', 'body "See attached."', 'body="See attached."'),

]

for row in criteria:
    print({'Criterion': row[0], 'Exact Quote from Task': row[1], 'Implementation': row[2]})

print('target set:', resolved_recipients, 'count=', len(resolved_recipients))
print('attachment:', attachment_file_paths)

# Send the email with updated zip attachment
pw=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords();
creds={p['account_name']:p['password'] for p in pw}

# login tokens

gm_token=apis.gmail.login(username='jefsmith@gmail.com', password=creds['gmail'])['access_token']

email_addresses=['ca-smit@gmail.com','masmith@gmail.com']
subject='Good Old Times'
body='See attached.'

resp=apis.gmail.send_email(
